pack.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0
pack.description: CSF 2.0 function themes for architecture evidence (Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover).

rules.title: Organizational context documented (GV)
rules.description: Architecture must state mission drivers, stakeholders, and risk tolerance informing security decisions.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture organizational context in systemName and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Risk management strategy aligned (GV)
rules.description: Security architecture should reference enterprise risk management strategy and appetite.
rules.remediationGuidance: Link risk appetite in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Roles and responsibilities for cybersecurity (GV)
rules.description: Named security roles for the system must be identifiable in governance metadata.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record roles in governance.ComplianceTags and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Policy established and communicated (GV)
rules.description: Applicable security policies must be referenced — not absent or generic.
rules.remediationGuidance: Cite policy IDs in governance.ComplianceTags and governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Asset inventory maintained (ID.AM)
rules.description: Systems, data, and services must be inventoried in the architecture manifest.
rules.remediationGuidance: Ensure complete services[] and datastores[] with ownership tags.

rules.title: Business environment understood (ID.BE)
rules.description: Architecture should document business processes supported and criticality tiers.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe business context in metadata.ChangeDescription and services[].Purpose.

rules.title: Governance and risk assessment (ID.RA)
rules.description: Threat and vulnerability assessment themes must be referenced for the system.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document risk assessment cadence in governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Improvement from assessments (ID.IM)
rules.description: Findings from assessments should feed architecture improvements — documented closure loop.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note improvement backlog in metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Identity management and access control (PR.AA)
rules.description: Identity lifecycle and access control must be documented per NIST protect function.
rules.remediationGuidance: Align with entra-iam themes in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Data security (PR.DS)
rules.description: Data at rest, in transit, and in use protections must be documented.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag encryption and DLP on datastores[].Tags and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Platform security (PR.PS)
rules.description: Platform hardening (OS, container, PaaS config) must reference secure baselines.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document platform baseline in governance.RequiredControls; align with azureExtractor.

rules.title: Technology infrastructure resilience (PR.IR)
rules.description: Resilience controls (backup, DR, HA) must be documented.
rules.remediationGuidance: Cross-reference DR tags in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Awareness and training themes (PR.AT)
rules.description: Security training for operators of the system should be referenced where human error is material.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note training hooks in governance.ComplianceTags for admin-facing systems.

rules.title: Data protection processes (PR.DP)
rules.description: Data handling procedures (classification, retention, disposal) must be documented.
rules.remediationGuidance: Align with data-classification tags in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Continuous monitoring (DE.CM)
rules.description: Security monitoring coverage must map assets and threats to log sources.
rules.remediationGuidance: List monitoring in governance.RequiredControls and services[].Tags.

rules.title: Adverse event analysis (DE.AE)
rules.description: SIEM rules and analytics for detecting adverse events must be documented.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe detection use cases in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Incident management (RS.MA)
rules.description: Incident response plan integration with architecture must be explicit.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document IR hooks in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Incident analysis and mitigation (RS.AN)
rules.description: Containment and eradication levers (isolate subnet, revoke tokens) must be identifiable.
rules.remediationGuidance: List mitigation actions in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Incident recovery (RS.MI)
rules.description: Recovery procedures after incidents must align with DR and backup narratives.
rules.remediationGuidance: Cross-reference DR runbooks in metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Recovery planning (RC.RP)
rules.description: Disaster recovery plans must be documented and tested.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document DR plans in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Recovery improvements (RC.IM)
rules.description: Post-incident and DR test improvements must feed back to architecture.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note recovery improvements in governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Supply chain risk management (GV.SC)
rules.description: Third-party and software supply chain risks must be enumerated.
rules.remediationGuidance: List suppliers on external services and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Secure software development (PR.PS-SDLC)
rules.description: Custom code must reference SSDF-aligned secure development practices.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document SDLC in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Configuration management (PR.PS-CM)
rules.description: Secure configuration baselines and drift detection must be documented.
rules.remediationGuidance: Align config baseline with azureExtractor and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Network segmentation (PR.IR-NS)
rules.description: Network zones and segmentation must be documented for protect function.
rules.remediationGuidance: Map network zones in metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Logging and audit (DE.CM-LOG)
rules.description: Audit logs must be protected, retained, and time-synchronized.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document log retention in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Vulnerability management (ID.RA-VM)
rules.description: Vulnerability scanning and remediation SLAs must be documented.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture VM program in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: CSF profile and target tier documented
rules.description: Architecture should state which CSF implementation tier or profile applies — not claim full maturity without evidence.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note CSF profile in governance.ComplianceTags and metadata.ChangeDescription.
